issues.description: The problem tasks explicitly state that ExcellenceLand has a private attribute 'rides' of type List<Ride>, but the solution implementation declares 'rides' as public (public List<Ride> rides;). This visibility mismatch can confuse students about the required encapsulation and may cause automated checks that expect a private field to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the 'rides' attribute private in the implementation to match the problem statement (change 'public List<Ride> rides;' to 'private List<Ride> rides;') and ensure a public getter 'getRides()' is provided. Update both the template and solution files accordingly so students implement and see the intended encapsulation.
